rationale:
Strengths: The agent verified identity via full name + ZIP and matched a single user. It looked up orders, correctly identified that the earbuds are in pending order #W5061109, presented valid blue variants with prices, explicitly summarized the intended change and requested confirmation, then executed the modification using the correct item and payment method. The price difference and refund amount were computed correctly and communicated accurately.

Issue leading to fail: The agent asserted, both before and after the modification, that “no further modifications or cancellations can be made to this order.” There is no support from the tools or stated policy for this blanket restriction. The policy indicates actions depend on order status and product rules; since the order remained pending and no tool indicated it became locked, this statement is an unsupported fabrication. Per the evaluation criteria, providing fabricated or unsupported information fails the pass bar even if the rest of the flow was correct.
